title: Maximum Coins Heroes Can Collect
summary: Given n heroes and m monsters with their respective powers, and an array of coins for each monster, determine the maximum coins each hero can collect by defeating monsters.
statement: Given n heroes and m monsters with their respective powers, and an array of coins for each monster, determine the maximum coins each hero can collect by defeating monsters. Heroes can defeat a monster if their power is greater than or equal to the monster's power. Each monster can be defeated by a hero only once.
constraints: A hero defeats every monster whose power is at most the hero value and collects its coins.
Return total collectible coins independently for each hero in input order.
hints: Sorting monsters converts each hero’s defeatable set into a prefix.
Sort power/coin pairs and build cumulative coin sums.
Use upper-bound search for each hero and read that prefix total.
Every monster before the boundary is defeatable and every later monster is too strong.
editorial: Every monster before the boundary is defeatable and every later monster is too strong.

tests.explanation: Heroes with powers one, four, and two collect totals five, sixteen, and ten.
Power five defeats all three monsters and collects sixty coins.
